title: Dragon Ball Super Remake Gives Frieza’s Return a Major Upgrade
content:
Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has officially kicked off the Resurrection F arc with its newest episode, and with it has given Frieza’s return a major upgrade compared to the original version. Dragon Ball Super has been offering up a newly enhanced take on the now classic TV anime series from over a decade ago, and the first episodes of the new series had revealed how the Battle of Gods arc had been upgraded from its original release . Now it’s time to see how it works out in the next arc.

With the previous episode of Dragon Ball Super: Beerus wrapping up its take on the Battle of Gods arc as Goku and Beerus’ fight had come to its end , the new remake series can now move forward with the next arc. Resurrection F had been one of the more divisive arcs from the original film and TV versions seen before, and this new remake offers a chance to make up from those previous missteps. And that seems to be heading in a promising direction already.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode 7 Amps Up Frieza’s Resurrection

Following the post-credits scene at the end of the previous episode , the Resurrection F start has now begun as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus sees Sorbet and the rest of the surviving Frieza Force scouring the universe for the Dragon Balls. Coming to Earth, they are able to successfully wish to revive the villain thanks to Emperor Pilaf and his gang collecting the balls to make their own wish. And by the end of the episode, Frieza has come back to life. Which already makes it feel speedier than before.

The original version of the Resurrection F arc in Dragon Ball Super ‘s TV series only ran for 9 episodes compared to the 18 seen with the Battle of Gods arc, so it does raise some questions as to how long the arc is going to last for in the remake. With Battle of Gods wrapping up its own events within six episodes, the new version might end up moving through Frieza’s return even quicker than that. But the overall episode count of the new series has yet to be confirmed as of this time .

What’s Next for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ?

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has been confirmed to share new versions of the Battle of Gods, Resurrection F and Universe 6 sagas before it comes to an end. It’s likely going to continue through the rest of the Fall 2026 slate, and end sometime in January or February by the time it gets through all three arcs. With the three arcs spanning nearly 50 episodes during their initial run, and 19 episodes for the Universe 6 arcs, ending sometime during the Winter 2027 broadcast schedule does make a lot of sense .

There are still the Goku Black and Universe Survival Sagas left on the table for a potential remake of this kind, but nothing of the sort has been revealed to be in the works at this time. With Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol also now in the works as it plans to adapt one of the future arcs only seen in the manga , there could be a lot more Dragon Ball Super anime on the way than fans might realize.

What are you hoping to see in this new take on Frieza’s return in Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ? How have you liked the reboot so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Gives the Anime a Cool Makeover Ahead of Jump Festa 2027 Update
content:
Jujutsu Kaisen has been gearing up to make a reveal about the anime’s future during Jump Festa 2027 later this December, and the franchise has given Yuji Itadori and the others a cool makeover before this coming update. Jujutsu Kaisen kicked off the first phase of the Culling Game arc from Gege Akutami’s original manga series earlier this year, and thankfully confirmed that a fourth season was already in the works. And we’re going to get a new update on it soon enough.

Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4: The Culling Game Part 2 has been announced to be in the works , but not much has been revealed about when it’s potentially going to hit. That’s likely to change with a new update coming our way as part of Jump Festa 2027 later this December as Jujutsu Kaisen is one of the major Shonen Jump franchises showing something off. And to get ready for it, MAPPA has dropped a cool makeover for Yuji and the others with a special new visual. Check it out in action below.

Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Hypes Jump Festa 2027 Update

Jump Festa 2027 is this year’s iteration of Shueisha’s annual event where they showcase some of their biggest manga and anime titles. Taking place over the December 19-20 weekend in Japan , this is where fans get the first major updates for all of the new projects now in the works for the coming year and beyond. Jujutsu Kaisen has yet to reveal what exactly it’s going to showcase during its own panel for the event, but it’s still exciting nonetheless as we’ll get an update on the franchise’s future.

Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4: The Culling Game Part 2 has yet to confirm a concrete release date, window or international release plans as of this time. All that has been revealed thus far is that it will be continuing through the Culling Game arc, and that Takeru Sato would be taking over as director from Shota Goshozono for studio MAPPA. The rest of the production staff, potential returning voice cast, new additions and more have yet to be revealed. So any update on those fronts would absolutely be welcome.

What to Know for Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4

The Culling Game Arc is the penultimate arc of Gege Akutami’s original Jujutsu Kaisen manga, and that means this next season is going to bring the anime one crucial step closer to the grand finale. The fallout of Kenjaku’s plan for the tournament combined with Sukuna’s mysterious plans for Megumi and Yuji will combine together to expand into even more chaos in the coming episodes. It’s all going to get much worse for Yuji and the others, undoubtedly.

It’s been about five or so months since Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 dropped its last major teaser, so Jump Festa 2027 would make for a perfect time for the franchise to drop a new trailer heading into the new year. It would also be great to get a release update for the episodes, but for now catch up with it all now streaming with platforms such as Crunchyroll, Hulu, and Netflix in the meantime. What are you hoping to see from Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 at Jump Festa 2027? Let us know all of your thoughts in the comments.

title: New Mashle Live-Action Movie Reveals Best Look at Its Hero Yet
content:
The live-action Mash Burndead gets his best look yet in a new official update. 2027 is going to be a huge year for Mashle: Magic and Muscles fans with the anime’s return and the live-action movie. Based on Hajime Komoto’s Weekly Shonen Jump hit, the anime still has a lot of chapters left to cover even though the manga reached its conclusion in 2020. Season 2 concluded in March 2024 , and a third season was announced soon afterward, the wait was still longer than expected. The anime is all set for its return in January next year as part of the Winter 2027 lineup.

On the other hand, the franchise is also expanding next year with a live-action movie. The live-action announcement earlier this month caused quite a lot of buzz, especially since fans weren’t expecting a new adaptation around the same time as the anime’s return. While the series has yet to share more updates on the live-action movie, the official X handle drops a new look at Mackenyu, who will be playing the role of Mash Burndead. Mackenyu is known for his excellent performance in several live-action adaptations, including One Piece , where he is loved by fans for playing the role of Roronoa Zoro. The visual reveals his appearance as Mash while he eats a cream puff, something the character probably loves more than anything else.

When Is Mashle: Magic and Muscles Live-Action Movie Getting Released?

The movie will hit the Japanese theatres on March 19th, 2027. However, international fans still await a release date, which might take at least a few months. Live-action movies aren’t always released in U.S. theatres, but there’s still a possibility that fans will be able to watch the movie with subtitles on a streaming platform. However, nothing can be certain before the movie’s premiere. While Warner Bros. and Fuji TV are overseeing the film, CREDEUS is handling the production, and TOHO is overseeing the distribution across Japan. The movie has yet to release a full-length trailer, but fans already have high expectations after watching the teaser thanks to the casting and the visuals.

What to Expect From Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3

The third season will continue the Divine Visionary Selection Exam Arc, the third story arc of the manga. Depending on the episode count, we can also expect the upcoming season to adapt some chapters from the fourth Tri-Magic-Athalon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc, the second final story arc. The second season finale confirms that the secret about Mash having no magic power is revealed to the kingdom.

It’s no surprise that the public is extremely outraged, and they want nothing more than to see him get executed, just like every other non-magic user in the kingdom. However, Mash’s friends and Wahlberg manage to buy him some time. His fate will be decided after the candidate exam is over. The third season also needs to focus more on his origins that will explain the reason he is unable to use magic at all.

What are your expectations for the Mashle: Magic and Muscles live-action? Which moment are you most excited to watch in the movie? Share your thoughts in the comments below!

title: Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 Teases Mizu’s Return With New Look
content:
Blue Eye Samurai is now closer than ever to its return to Netflix for the animated series’ second season, and a new preview has shared a new look at Mizu’s big comeback for the new episodes. The animated series has been one of the biggest success stories with Netflix in the last few years as not only has it nabbed some Emmy awards wins with its initial debut , but fans are eager to see what’s coming next on Mizu’s path to vengeance as it takes her out of Japan.

Blue Eye Samurai has made fans wait quite a bit for its second season , but it’s finally making its way to Netflix next year. With the second season of the animated series and a third and final one on the way after that, ScreenRant has shared a special preview image for Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 showing off more of Mizu in action. You can check it out below to get ready for the new episodes.

When Does Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 Come Out?

Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 will be making its worldwide debut with Netflix on January 19th next year with co-creators Amber Noizumi and Michael Green returning to serve as writers and executive producers once more. It’s yet to be revealed how many episodes this new season will be running for, but Erwin Stoff serves as an executive producer with Jane Wu as supervising director and producer with animation produced by Blue Spirit like seen with the first season. It’s also going to feature many returning voice stars for the new episodes too.

Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 has confirmed the returns of stars such as Maya Erskine as Mizu, Brenda Song as Akemi, Darren Barnet as Taigen, Masi Oka as Ringo, and Kenneth Branagh as Abijah Fowler. There might be other potential returning faces from the first season that have yet to be revealed at this time, but new additions to the cast for the coming season include Jonathan Pryce as Old Violet, Joel Kim Booster as Priest Ando, and Sherry Cola as Kuma. But there’s still much we don’t know about the coming season yet.

What’s Next for Mizu in Blue Eye Samurai Season 2?

Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 will be picking up right from where the first season left off as Mizu has entered a very tenuous agreement with Fowler . After noting that the ones she’s looking for are in London, this next season will see Mizu heading into this strange new territory and dealing with all sorts of new challenges as a result. “For the first time, she’ll have to confront what it’s like to stand out as Asian in a sea of white faces,” the creators have previously teased. “And then find out what it means to be a woman during one of the most oppressive times in English history.”

Blue Eye Samurai is returning for its second season next year, but has also confirmed it’s now in the works on its third but final season coming after that. No release window has been set for the final season as of this time, but at least fans can rest easy knowing that they will be able to see Mizu’s story come to its end. Whatever kind of ending that might be for her. What are you hoping to see in Blue Eye Samurai Season 2? Let us know your thoughts about it in the comments.

HT – ScreenRant

title: Lost Kids WB Classic Is Finally Coming to Streaming After 23 Years
content:
A lost classic from the Kids WB! Saturday morning cartoons library is finally set to make its streaming debut after 23 long years, and it’s going to be available totally for free. Tubi has been making great strides in the past year especially to make Warner Bros. Animation classic library more accessible than it ever has been before , and that’s even more true thanks to the fact that all of these shows have been available for free on a rotational schedule that’s seen lots of shuffled releases.

Tubi this Fall had kicked off a slate of releases for Kids WB! block fans that saw shows like Mucha Lucha and more return to streaming after being missing in action for basically decades outside of their initial home video releases or digital storefront purchases. But as November comes to an end and December 1st fast approaches, Tubi has revealed a new slate of streaming releases coming to the platform that notably includes the fan favorite, Xiaolin Showdown .

Xiaolin Showdown Comes to Tubi This December 2026

As Tubi announced on their official social media, Foster’s Home for Imaginary Friends, Mucha Lucha , and Beetlejuice will be leaving the platform on December 1st. But in their place will be new additions to the platform Xiaolin Showdown, Wacky Races, MAD, and Duck Dodgers . It’s also been revealed that a number of classic Cartoon Network movies and specials will be returning to the platform at the same time including Dexter’s Laboratory: Ego Trip, Ed, Edd n Eddy’s Jingle Jingle Jangle, Ed, Edd n Eddy’s Hanky Panky Hullabaloo, Ed, Edd n Eddy’s Big Picture Show , and Ed, Edd n Eddy’s Boo Haw Haw.

The full breakdown of new additions to Tubi on December 1st is as such:

• Xiaolin Showdown

• Wacky Races

• MAD

• Duck Dodgers

• Dexter’s Laboratory: Ego Trip

• Ed, Edd n Eddy’s Jingle Jingle Jangle

• Ed, Edd n Eddy’s Hanky Panky Hullabaloo

• Ed, Edd n Eddy’s Big Picture Show

• Ed, Edd n Eddy’s Boo Haw Haw.

Why You Should Watch Xiaolin Showdown

Kids WB! might not be as fondly remembered as other competing Saturday morning cartoon blocks at the time such as Fox Kids and One Saturday Mornings, but it had a lot of gems under its belt for action fans. Originally created by Christy Hui in 2003, the series introduced fans to a group of kids training in specialty martial arts fighting to protect mysterious artifacts known as the Shen Gong Wu. Episodes often had contests for these items with one Xiaolin warrior facing off an enemy, and often saw the items bounce back and forth between the sides.

The series had lots of fun action and often had an imaginative third act which saw multiple different types of contests take place that pit different skills against one another for these magical items. It led to episodes that really took fans by surprise, and three seasons that told a serialized story (before coming back for a reboot years later). Now that it’s coming to Tubi, it’s the perfect time to go back and see why it was so fun on Saturdays.

Are you going to check out Xiaolin Showdown now that it’s coming to Tubi? Where does it rank among your Kids WB! favorites? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: New Fantasy Isekai Confirms Winter 2027 Launch With First Look Trailer – Watch
content:
A new fantasy isekai confirms the Winter 2027 lineup with a new trailer. Now that 2026 is finally closer to its end, the 2027 anime lineup is getting broader by the day. It’s evident so far that it will be yet another exciting year for anime fans. 2026 was a huge year for isekai fans, especially since the major Crunchyroll series such as Re:Zero , Mushoku Tensei, and That Time I Got Reincarnated As a Slime released their new seasons. However, it’s not just three anime, but the anime industry continues to expand the isekai genre. While some might argue that the industry is becoming oversaturated with isekai series, the reason behind it is that fans have been getting so many of these shows because of the high demand.

2027 will open with an exciting Winter lineup where fans will be getting the sequel seasons of Mashle: Magic and Muscles , Shangri-La Frontier, and more. Among the new debuts, one of the isekai series that stands out is The Reincarnated Elf Left on a Journey to Master His Magic and With His Extra Lifespan Became a Living Legend . The title is extremely long, which isn’t too different from the usual fantasy isekai fans have been getting over the years. title: After 15 Years, Surprise Action Series Confirms Return With New Anime Revival
content:
A classic action series has surprisingly announced it’s coming back with a new anime revival to help celebrate its 15th anniversary. If you are of a certain age, you might have noticed how there have been many classic anime and manga franchises coming back with new anime adaptations . Revivals and reboots have led to a lot of nostalgic successes in the last few years, and that’s opened the doors to all sorts of new releases for fans to keep an eye out for. That’s the case for Aria the Scarlet Ammo too.

The anime adaptation for Chugaku Akamatsu and Kobuichi’s Aria the Scarlet Ammo light novel series is now celebrating the 15th anniversary of its original anime debut , and Kadokawa has confirmed that the franchise is going all out for the occasion. Aria the Scarlet Ammo is returning with a new anime short scheduled to make its debut next year, and has revealed the first look at some of the new and returning faces fans will see in action with the revival.

New Aria the Scarlet Ammo Anime Short Announced for 15th Anniversary

Officially titled Aria the Scarlet Ammo Corto , the new revival anime short is currently scheduled for a release next year. No concrete release date or potential international release plans have been announced as of this time, but it’s going to feature familiar faces behind the scenes. Original series writer Chugaku Akamatsu is overseeing the script together with the Kenji Saito with Yoshifumi Sasahara is directing the new revival at BELLNOX FILMS. It’s not a familiar production staff from the original series, but it will sound familiar.

Returning voice cast members announced to return for Aria the Scarlet Ammo Corto include the likes of Rie Kugimiya as Aria H. Kanzaki, Junji Majima as Kinji Toyama, Mikako Takahashi as Shirayuki Hotogi, Mariya Ise as Riko Mine, Kaori Ishihara as Reki, and Ayako Kawasumi as Jeanne d’Arc. New additions to the cast making their debut in this new revival short include Emiri Iwai as Lisa Ave du Ank, Miyari Nemoto as Minuet Holmes, and Anzu Haruno as Nemo Rinkarun. They can be seen in action with this first look poster you find above.

What Is Aria the Scarlet Ammo ?

Aria the Scarlet Ammo likely isn’t the first action series you think of when imagining all of the potential revivals and reboots that could be coming down the pipeline next, but it’s likely one of those 2010s anime gems that just shook loose in your memory. The series is set in a school where students are trained in a deadly martial art known as Butei that teaches them how to use various weapons and other assassin skills. When Toyama is attacked by an assassin setting out to kill Butei fighters, he’s soon saved by the prodigy Aria.

Aria the Scarlet Ammo technically ran for two seasons, but the second season was more of a spinoff story about a different character connected to Aria. So this is the first proper continuation of the anime since that first season came to an end in 2011. It’s a return from the 2010s wave of franchises , and we’re likely to get much more. How do you feel about Aria the Scarlet Ammo making its comeback? Let us know your thoughts in the comments.

title: Netflix’s One Piece Season 3 Readies for Launch With New Behind-the-Scenes Teases
content:
One Piece ‘s live-action series is fast approaching its return to Netflix next year, and it’s one step closer to that launch with the start of a new wave of behind-the-scenes videos showing off more of the series’ production. One Piece has been an incredible success for Netflix ever since the live-action series first made its debut . Quickly renewed for not just one, but two new seasons, the team behind it all has been hard at work on adapting Eiichiro Oda’s massive manga series for the past few years.

One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta is the third major season of the live-action series as it sees Luffy and the Straw Hats heading into Alabasta in order to save Princess Vivi’s kingdom , but it has yet to confirm a proper release date as of this time. But now that seems closer than ever before as One Piece will begin to release a series of special behind the scenes videos to give fans a better look at how Season 2 all came together. It’s time to get hyped.

When Does One Piece Season 3 Come Out on Netflix?

One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta is currently scheduled for a release with Netflix sometime in 2027 , but has yet to nail down a more concrete release date or window as of this time. This new wave of behind the scenes videos for the second season kick off a new project that will likely lead to the reveal of when this third season is finally coming our way. With promotional materials for the franchise heating up once more, it’s time to start looking ahead to what could be coming our way in this new season.

One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta will be expanding its roles for some of the major players who debuted in the second season such as Mikaela Hoover as Tony Tony Chopper, Charithra Chandran as Princess Vivi, Sendhil Ramamurthy as Nefartari Cobra, Lera Abova as Nico Robin, and Joe Manganiello as Sir Crocodile ( who has been steadily teasing his return for the past few months as well ). Serving as the Straw Hats’ first major battle on the Grand Line, this could be a major turning point for the franchise.

What’s New for One Piece Season 3 on Netflix?

One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta will also be introducing many new faces to the expanding cast with the introduction of this new region too such as Xolo Maridueña as Ace , Cole Escola as Bon Clay, Awdo Awdo as Mr. 1, Daisy Head as Miss Doublefinger, Emilio Sakraya as Koza, Omid Abtahi as Toto, Jamie Ward as Pell, and Nabeel Khan as Chaka revealed thus far. But there will likely be many other new faces revealed the closer we get to Season 3’s big debut in the coming months.

With the franchise revealing more behind the scenes information for the second season, it’s going to give fans the best look yet at how production has been thinking in their approach to it all. This is going to be very important heading into the third season as the future of the live-action series remains uncertain , but we’ll have to see how it shakes out soon enough. But what do you want to see from One Piece ‘s live-action series next? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Major Shonen Jump Series Officially Ends After 6 Years With Final Release
content:
Another major series has ended its run in the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine after six years of serialization with the release of its final chapter, and it makes the 14th title coming to an end this year overall. It’s the final transitional phase for Shonen Jump for the year as a final batch of series are coming to their ends, and a few new titles are kicking off their own runs. And following the end of Kenta Shinohara’s Witch Watch last week , Yuto Suzuki’s Sakamoto Days has now come to an end.

Yuto Suzuki’s Sakamoto Days has now officially come to an end with Shonen Jump with the release of Chapter 284, six years after it originally made its debut. The series has been in the midst of its final arc for the past year, so fans have been preparing to say goodbye to the series for quite some time. But with many more fans assuming it would end earlier this Summer, the story was able to take its time and reach a more conclusive finale than many other Shonen Jump titles get .

Sakamoto Days Ends in Shonen Jump After 6 Years With Chapter 284

Sakamoto Days comes to an end with the release of Chapter 284 , and the series puts a final stamp on Taro Sakamoto’s journey overall. Following the final fight with X, the penultimate chapter of the series moved time ahead a year or so to the birth of the Sakamoto family’s next child. With the JAA being dismantled and assassins no longer being needed, Sakamoto starts a whole new group to take its place that uses non-lethal tactics for its takedowns instead in order to keep the power balance.

Sakamoto’s dream of turning his convenience store into a franchise has also worked with a chain of stores across the region, and the final chapter reveals how each of the survivors (both friends and former foes) have since gone on to live new lives that don’t focus on killing. It’s a bright future for everyone as the world finds a new era of peace after everything that’s happened, and it’s clear that Sakamoto has indeed had an impact on everyone he’s come across through his time as a deadly killer.

What’s Next for Shonen Jump ?

Though Sakamoto Days has now come to an end, thankfully it’s far from the end of the franchise on a whole. The anime is set to return to screens with Season 2 in January , and it’s already looking to keep up the hot streak. As for Shonen Jump , this is the 14th major title to come to an end this year but only the sixth series to end under its own terms without being cancelled. The number of titles that have ended in 2026 break down as such:

• Otr of the Flame

• Harukaze Mound

• Gonron Egg

• The Mage Next Door

• Hero Girl and Demon Lord Call It Quits

• Alien Headbutt

• Kinato’s Magic

• Drawn to the Fire

• Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo

• Hima-ten!

• Blue Box

• The Elusive Samurai

• Witch Watch

• Sakamoto Days

With one new series still scheduled to make its debut next week following the return of two major creators that have started off their own new works , it likely means there will be one more series ended before 2026 comes to an end. But how are you feeling about Sakamoto Days coming to an end? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.
